## Release gates

- [ ] `cd benchmark-roadmap && npm run gates`
- [ ] Default Top-K uses only official/independent comparable results
- [ ] Versions, subsets, metrics and protocols remain isolated
- [ ] No token, Cookie, `.env`, credential dump, private path or restricted data
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and caveats updated when needed
